query: I'm designing "KEP-5681: Conditional Authorization" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "Only one ConditionSet exposed as part of SubjectAccessReview status". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, exposing only one `ConditionSet` as part of the `SubjectAccessReview` status was considered in **`keps/sig-auth/5681-conditional-authorization/README.md`** under the section **"Only one ConditionSet exposed as part of SubjectAccessReview status"**.

It was not adopted because:
- If only a single condition set is exposed, it might make it impossible for a user to understand all the conditions they are subject to for a given request via a `(Self/Local/Standard) SubjectAccessReview`.
- Specifically, the first conditional response encountered might merely be a "deny dangerous operations"-type conditional response. 
- Therefore, the user needs to see all conditional allows and denies until an unconditional response is reached.
